title: Foundations of the Scaling Law
abstract: arXiv:2610.27789v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Empirical scaling laws relate validation loss to model size, training exposure and compute, providing a quantitative basis for allocating resources. This technical note explains these relationships through three linked analyses. Geometric approximation connects spatial resolution, intrinsic dimension and smoothness to function error; the loss function determines how that error transfers to task risk. Spectral analysis combines feature visibility, covariance eigenvalues and target alignment to describe how additional data reduce unresolved predictive mass. Constrained optimization then gives the parameter-data balance and the training-inference trade-off. We also examine emergence and grokking, separating scoring thresholds from learning dynamics, and test-time scaling, separating candidate coverage from selected-answer accuracy. translated_abstract: 经验缩放定律将验证损失与模型规模、训练数据量和计算量联系起来，为资源分配提供了定量基础。本技术报告通过三个相互关联的分析来解释这些关系：几何近似将空间分辨率、内在维度和平滑度与函数误差联系起来，而损失函数决定了该误差如何传递为任务风险；谱分析结合特征可见性、协方差特征值和目标对齐，描述了更多数据如何减少尚未解决的预测不确定性；约束优化则给出了参数与数据的平衡以及训练与推理之间的权衡。我们还研究了涌现与顿悟现象，将评分阈值与学习动力学区分开来；并研究了测试时缩放，将候选答案的覆盖范围与所选答案的准确率区分开来。在视觉和分子预测上的应用展示了领域特定的坐标选择如何改变资源比较方式。
tldr: 本论文通过几何近似、谱分析和约束优化三个相互关联的分析框架，为缩放定律建立了理论基础，并区分解释了涌现、顿悟和测试时缩放等现象。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes theoretical foundations for empirical scaling laws through three linked analyses—geometric approximation, spectral analysis, and constrained optimization—while disentangling emergence, grokking, and test-time scaling phenomena.
